data.long_meaning: In Greek, Hamel means 'dedicated to God'. This name was used in the New Testament as the name of a man who welcomed Jesus into his home. Hamel is a strong and spiritual name for a boy, reminding us of our commitment to God and our duty to serve Him. The name Hamel carries the meaning “Dedicated to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hamel usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
